record.name: REPS - AI Fitness Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Your AI fitness coach counts every rep automatically—no logging, no guessing, just instant proof of work.

The hardest part about getting into noticeable shape isn't the workout…

It’s the lack of an immediate reward.

The brain gets discouraged when it doesn’t see progress.
The scale hasn't moved… the mirror looks the same...
Those clothes you used to wear still don’t fit.
This is why the motivation to keep going NEVER lasts.

So then how do fit people get the motivation to STAY fit?

Unfit people obsess over their weight, mirror pics, results.
Fit people feed off their inputs: “How much did I get done today?”

REPS tracks the only thing you can actually control: your daily rep output.

Your AI workout buddy uses computer vision to watch you train and automatically counts every rep.
No manual logging.
No "did I do 12 or 15?"
No wondering if your form was good enough to count.

The AI verifies your movement and awards points in real-time.
Every rep = 1 point.
It’s a scoreboard. Your own proof of work.
Every workout, you watch your points climb.
Every rep is undeniable proof that the work happened.

You're not waiting for the scale to move or comparing yourself to "enhanced" IG transformations.
You're just stacking reps while your AI coach keeps you accountable.

How it works:
- Perform bodyweight exercises (no equipment needed)
- Your AI workout buddy automatically counts your reps and checks your form
- Every rep = 1 point Instant feedback on every movement.
- Points unlock everything Avatar customization, new workouts, all unlocked through your REPS.
- Level up to unlock harder challenges. Each level introduces new movements and raises the intensity
- Reach LVL 20 to compete in global ranked matches. Climb from the depths of Copper to the most coveted— Obsidian rank.
- Join a faction and participate in team wars. Every week the counter resets and a team is awarded points and prizes.

Why this works when other solutions don't
Most other solutions fail because they:
* Require manual logging (so you quit after a week)
* Track outcomes instead of effort (so you feel like nothing's happening)
* Don’t reward you for showing up everyday

REPS removes all of the fluff and friction.
1. Open the app.
2. Do the work.
3. Your coach analyzes, counts, and corrects.
4. You get rewarded with points that can only be earned (never bought).

Download if you:
* Need a custom training protocol that adapts to your fitness level
* Want real-time feedback on your form and fitness progress, verified by an AI coach
* Are tired of wasting time at the gym only to be judged or interrupted during workouts
* Want to develop sustainable discipline (so you don’t have to rely on motivation)
* Want to compete with friends and see where you rank globally

Don't download if you:
* Prefer to take shortcuts when it comes to your health and fitness
* Are dependent on equipment to push yourself (REPS is bodyweight only)
* Prefer apps that track surface-level metrics like weight and mood
* Are not competitive or driven by becoming a better version of yourself

No equipment. No manual logging. No relying on the scale to keep you disciplined.
Just open the app, do the work, as your AI coach helps you on your fitness journey.

Privacy Policy: https://gotreps.app/#privacy
Contact: hello@gotreps.app


Download now and start putting in the REPS.

record.description_evidence:
FitFlow is your partner for weight loss, muscle gain, and lasting body transformation. We combine smart nutrition tracking with expert workout guidance to help you achieve your health goals. Join users worldwide who trust FitFlow for their daily fitness journey.

Effortless Nutrition Tracking
Stop spending hours logging meals. Our smart tools reduce manual logging effort significantly. Snap a photo of your meal for instant calorie, macro, and nutrition insights. You can also describe what you ate in plain language or scan barcodes for packaged foods. With access to a large library including restaurant nutrition data and whole foods, you get accurate nutrition facts and allergen information wherever you eat. Whether you follow vegetarian, vegan, keto, paleo, or gluten-free diets, FitFlow adapts to your preferences.

Smart Meal Planning
Get personalized meal plans aligned to your goals like weight loss or muscle gain. Receive tailored macro recommendations based on your body metrics and activity level. custom recipes, save homemade meals, and quick-log ingredients with our recipe builder. Don't forget to stay hydrated; track water intake and set hydration goals with built-in reminders.

Expert Workout Guidance
Access over 1,000 guided exercises with form tips and recommendations. Log sets, reps, weights, rest periods, cardio, and walking in one convenient workout tracker. Choose from dozens of trainer-curated workout programs covering strength training, HIIT, yoga, home workouts, and gym routines. Your plans adapt to your fitness level, schedule, and progress for truly personalized workouts.

Measurable Progress and Motivation
Track weight, nutrition, workouts, and body measurements through visual progress charts and fitness analytics. Set goals, beat personal records, and celebrate milestones. Reinforce consistency with achievements, medals, streaks, and challenge-style motivation loops. Compete on leaderboards for social motivation and accountability.

Flexible Plans for Every Goal
Start with our free fitness app plan that includes smart food scanning, calorie tracking, basic workout routines, and progress charts. Upgrade to Premium to unlock custom meal plans, detailed analytics, advanced workout programs, and personalized macro recommendations. Eligible Premium offers include a 14-day free trial so you can explore advanced features before subscribing.

Ready to transform your body and mind? Download FitFlow today and start your journey toward healthier eating, workout consistency, and long-term wellness.

record.description_evidence:
Meet Fitsune: Your all-in-one AI fitness companion that helps you train smarter, eat better, and recover faster.

Whether you're a beginner or advanced athlete, Fitsune adapts to YOUR body, YOUR goals, and YOUR schedule.

----------------------------------------------------------

PERSONALIZED WORKOUT PLANS
Get a custom training program built around your fitness level, available equipment, and training days. Full gym, home gym, outdoor, or bodyweight. Fitsune has you covered.
- Scientifically-designed exercises
- Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower, Full Body splits
- Smart adaptations for sensitive knees, back, shoulders and wrists
- Progressive overload tracking

PERFECT FORM, EVERY TIME
Never guess how to do an exercise again. Every single movement comes with a step-by-step video demonstration showing proper form, tempo, and technique. So you train safely and get real results.
- HD form videos for all exercises
- Learn correct posture and breathing
- Avoid common mistakes and injuries
- Perfect for beginners and pros alike

TRACK YOUR STRENGTH JOURNEY
See exactly how you're progressing on every single exercise. Fitsune builds individual progress charts for each movement, so you can visualize your gains week by week.
- Personal progression graphs per exercise
- Track weight, reps, and volume over time
- Spot plateaus early and adjust
- Celebrate every personal record

NUTRITION IN A SNAP
Tired of manually logging every meal? Just snap a photo and let our AI detect your food, calories, and macros instantly.
- AI-powered meal recognition
- Automatic calorie and macro tracking
- Daily nutrition targets based on your goals
- Water intake tracking

MUSCLE RECOVERY MAP
The first fitness app with a real-time 3D muscle recovery model. See exactly which muscles are sore, recovering, or ready to train.
- 12 muscle groups tracked individually
- 24h and 48h scientific recovery timers
- Never overtrain or waste a gym session again

STRENGTH RADAR AND RANK UP
Turn your progress into a game. Track your strength across chest, back, arms, legs, shoulders, and core. Rank up from E to S+ as you get stronger.

STREAK SYSTEM
Build unstoppable consistency with our workout streak tracker. Every session counts.

SMART GOAL TARGETING
Based on the scientific Mifflin-St Jeor formula, Fitsune calculates your ideal calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Plus tells you exactly how many weeks until you reach your goal weight.

DAILY SCIENCE-BACKED TIPS
Learn something new every day. Get one bite-sized, research-backed nutrition or training tip delivered daily.

----------------------------------------------------------

WHY FITSUNE?

Most fitness apps show you generic workouts. Fitsune analyzes YOUR goals, YOUR equipment, YOUR recovery status, and YOUR nutrition to give you exactly what you need - every single day.

No more:
- Random workout suggestions
- Confusing nutrition guides
- Overtraining injuries
- Bad form leading to injury
- Losing motivation

Just science-backed fitness, made simple.

----------------------------------------------------------

PREMIUM FEATURES
Upgrade to Fitsune Premium and unlock:
- Unlimited AI meal scans
- Advanced recovery insights
- Complete workout customization
- Full progress analytics
- Priority support

Weekly and yearly subscriptions available.
3-day free trial on yearly plan.

----------------------------------------------------------

Start your transformation today. Download Fitsune and train smarter, not harder.

Questions? Reach out: fox.fitsune@gmail.com

Subscription auto-renews unless canceled 24 hours before the period ends. Manage subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

record.publisher: Shenzhen Speediance Living Technology Co., Ltd.

record.description_evidence:
[Should I train today, recover, or change the plan?]
Aevis is the AI-native health agent for people who train. It brings your training, sleep, recovery, nutrition, goals and real-life context together to help decide what matters next — then keeps working as things change.

[DASHBOARDS BUILT AROUND YOU]
Your health doesn't fit into a fixed set of charts. Aevis can generate personalized dashboards, views and reports around what you actually want to understand — from training load and recovery to sleep, nutrition and longer-term trends.
Ask about something you care about, and Aevis can turn the relevant data into a view built for that question.

[PROACTIVE, NOT JUST REACTIVE]
Aevis doesn't have to wait for you to open the app and ask. It can keep track of what matters, reach out when something needs your attention, adapt plans as your situation changes, and follow up on what happens next.

[IT REMEMBERS THE CONTEXT]
Aevis keeps long-term context around your goals, preferences, training history, routines and past decisions, so every conversation doesn't have to start from zero.
Over time, it can understand not just today's numbers, but how they relate to what you've been doing and what you're trying to achieve.

[FROM HEALTH DATA TO THE NEXT MOVE]
Aevis brings training, sleep, recovery and nutrition into the same decision-making context. Instead of leaving you with another score to interpret, it helps answer practical questions like:
• Should I train normally today or back off?
• How should I adjust after a poor night of sleep?
• What has changed in my recovery recently?
• How should this week's training plan adapt?
• What patterns are showing up across my health data?

[FROM A DECISION TO REAL EXECUTION]
Aevis doesn't stop at recommendations. It can create and adjust training plans and turn decisions into actions.
With Speediance, Aevis can write workouts directly into supported training experiences, connecting health context, planning and execution in one continuous loop.

[BUILT TO STAY WITH THE WORK]
Aevis is designed as an agent, not just a chatbot. It can continue working across conversations, keep context over time, proactively take on ongoing tasks, and use connected tools to help move things forward.

[YOUR TRAINING, WITH YOUR WHOLE HEALTH IN VIEW]
Train with a system that can understand more than the workout itself — and keep adapting as your body, schedule and goals change.

Works with Apple Health.

Aevis is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent medical conditions.

record.name: FitnessKit: PT Client Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
FitnessKit is the operating system for personal trainers. An on-device AI drafts every client touchpoint — check-in replies, progress reports, form cues, the next step for each person on your roster — and you approve them in one queue. That's hours back every week, and the capacity to coach more clients without working more hours. Every client you bring on gets a premium training app of their own, free.

PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE AI
Every draft, insight and readiness score is generated on device using Apple's Foundation Models. It works offline, and your clients' training data never leaves the phone to be processed.

THE APPROVAL QUEUE
• One place to sign off everything your AI drafted, instead of chasing it across a dozen screens
• Drafted check-in replies you can edit inline before they send
• Monthly progress reports written for each client, ready for your co-sign
• Form cues pinned to the exact rep that needs them
• A proposed next step for every client who needs one
• Flows earn autopilot only after you've approved their drafts untouched — the AI graduates, you don't gamble
• Teach it your Coach Voice so the drafts already sound like you

YOUR ROSTER, AT A GLANCE
• Every client in one list, filtered by who's at risk or needs attention first
• Engagement and adherence per client, so nobody quietly drifts away
• Per-client AI readiness from recent training, sleep and recovery
• Real-time compliance charts across every active program
• A notification the moment a client finishes an assigned session, with full stats

PROGRAMS BUILT ONCE, ASSIGNED IN SECONDS
• Build multi-week programs with per-day workouts and progression rules
• Keep templates in your library and fork a working copy per client
• Assign straight into a client's schedule, or customise the start date and add a note
• Already have programs elsewhere? Paste them in and the AI rebuilds them week by week

AUTOMATE THE BUSYWORK
• Automation flows: a trigger, then a sequence of steps that run themselves
• Recurring check-ins that go out on your cadence and come back structured
• Onboarding that runs itself the moment a new client connects

SESSIONS THAT SCHEDULE THEMSELVES
• Publish your availability and let clients book the slots that suit them
• A week view of everything booked, with cancellations and no-shows tracked
• Two-way calendar sync so your sessions live alongside the rest of your day

WHAT YOUR CLIENTS GET
• Their assigned programs and workouts, ready to train
• Log every set with reps, weight, duration and RPE as they go
• Set types, rest timers and live progress through every session
• Home Screen widgets and a Live Activity showing the set and rest timer on the Lock Screen
• 1:1 chat with you — answers, form cues and check-ins in one thread
• Record a lift and get a form score with the cues that matter
• A monthly progress report they can actually share

A HUGE EXERCISE LIBRARY
• Hundreds of exercises with video demonstrations and step-by-step instructions
• Filter by muscle group, equipment and exercise type
• Add custom exercises with the metadata that matters
• Per-exercise progress charts to watch strength climb over time
• HealthKit integration for heart rate and calories, and post workouts back to HealthKit

WHO IT'S FOR
Personal trainers coaching clients remotely, gyms running a floor of trainers, and anyone who wants their coaching to scale further than their calendar does.

Download FitnessKit and start coaching today.

We're always improving and would love your feedback: fitnesskit.com.au@gmail.com

record.description_evidence:
What is ArtiFit 

It is an AI-powered mobile app that helps people training at home, control their exercise technique and reach their fitness goals faster. 

How does ArtiFit work

It uses your smartphone camera and computer vision to track your workout technique, detect mistakes by comparing your performance to digital fitness models, and give feedback on how to perfect it. 

Real-time voice assistant and visual tips help you master your technique and keep you on track with the desired number of reps.

The app automatically logs your routine to the Analytics section of your personal profile — number of reps and sets, workout and rest duration, and intensity of your workout. 

What does ArtiFit offer

The app offers various workout plans based on your fitness level and targets.

The most popular bodyweight exercises for safe and effective workouts at home: squats, plank, push-ups, lunges, sumo squats, jumping squats, crunches, sit-ups, glute bridge, high plank, low-high plank, jumping jacks, donkey kicks.
You can use the Artifit with a 14-day money back guarantee.

How to start

Just install and open the app, and put your smartphone in front of you on the floor so that you can see yourself on the front camera. Choose the workout and go! 

ArtiFit operates locally on your smartphone, so your videos will only be seen by you. 

Work out efficiently and safely with an AI personal trainer rather than alone.

Email us if you have any questions: info@artifit.app

record.name: Onyx: Fitness & AI Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Onyx reads your Apple Watch, your bloodwork, your training and your food — and tells you what to do today.

Most fitness apps show you a dashboard and leave you to work it out. Onyx opens with a sentence and a button. Train hard, or don't. Eat this next. Be in bed by 10:45. Every answer comes from your own data, and every answer says why.

READINESS, READ EVERY MORNING
Overnight HRV, resting heart rate, sleep and breathing become one score before you're out of bed. Then the day spends it: a heavy session, a long walk or a stressful afternoon each cost, and each fades over the hours that follow. When your body is asking for rest, Recovery Mode eases the plan for a few days.

A COACH THAT KNOWS YOUR DATA
Ask anything. "Should I train today?" "Why has my HRV been low this week?" "Build me 45 minutes with dumbbells." Coach answers from your last two weeks — not a generic script — and builds the session on the spot.

RUNS, WALKS AND RIDES, LIVE
Live pace, distance, splits, your heart-rate zone as a colour, and the route drawing itself. Your week's cardio load is measured against what the last four conditioned you for, with zone minutes, records and VO₂ max beside it.

HOW OLD IS YOUR BODY, REALLY?
Biological age from VO₂ max, resting heart rate, HRV, sleep, steps, exercise — and LDL and HbA1c once your bloodwork is in. See what's raising it, what's lowering it, and the habits that move it.

YOUR BLOODWORK, READ AND ACTED ON
Photograph a lab report or import the PDF. Every marker is charted against its range and tracked across draws. Flagged results become one-tap changes: ease training while iron is low, raise fibre when LDL is high. Your first report is free. A heads-up, not a diagnosis.

TRAINING THAT COUNTS WHAT YOU DID
The lift that deserves you fresh goes first. Only the sets you ticked count. Multi-week blocks that build, peak and deload, with cardio days in them. Every session graded.

TWO SCORES ON EVERY FOOD
Scan a barcode, snap a plate, read a menu, or just say it. Every product gets its own score — processing, additives, nutrient quality — and a second one for you, today, from your bloodwork, readiness and training. Meals you log appear in Apple Health.

NOTIFICATIONS, ON YOUR CLOCK
Timed to when you wake, train, eat and sleep. At most three a day, never overnight.

YOUR BODY, THEN A SENTENCE
An eight-domain wheel shows where you're even and where you're lopsided; tap any domain for its grade and the lever to pull. Onyx notices resting heart rate creeping up and HRV drifting down a day or two before you feel it.

ON YOUR WRIST
The Watch runs a session without your phone: last and best weight on every set, a rest ring you can read across the rack, and live heart rate. Nine widgets for Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Scores, trends and plans are worked out on your iPhone. Sync goes to your own private iCloud, which we can't read. When Coach or a photo needs a larger AI model, only what's needed is sent, without your name. Never sold, never used for ads, never used to train AI.

FREE, AND ONYX PRO
Everything your iPhone works out is free: readiness, illness early-warning, session grades, cardio load, biological age, the adaptive program, Recovery Mode and both food scores. Onyx Pro is Coach, unlimited — plus unlimited meal logging by photo or description, the meal planner, menu reading and every bloodwork report after your first. Monthly, yearly and lifetime options; a free week where available. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period and are managed in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://glib-cruiser-371.notion.site/Privacy-Policy-2faf53f04b2180269281c97d08e7c2e6

Onyx is not a medical device and does not diagnose. Talk to your doctor about your results.

HaiLife is a fitness app with a coach built in. Pick up to 3 goals and HaiLife builds your Today screen, your training plan and your food targets around them.

YOUR TODAY
• Built from your goals: one coach note, one main card and a few more
• Edit Home to hide and reorder cards, or ask your coach to redesign it, with a preview before anything changes
• Prefer the classic layout? Bring back the old Today in one tap

YOUR COACH
• Talk or type with your AI coach about plans, workouts, food and form
• A planning wizard builds your full week, then your coach walks you through it
• Your coach keeps watch: missed sessions, low-recovery days and plateaus turn into suggested changes you can accept or undo
• Coach updates lists every change, with Undo
• Bring your history from another AI, so your first plan starts from your real past

TRAIN
• Gym player with set tracking, rest timers and a Live Activity
• Ride recording with GPS, power, heart rate and training load
• Sessions that adapt to how recovered you are today

FUEL
• Daily calorie and macro targets from your plan
• Log meals by photo, voice or text
• Meal plans and a grocery list you can send to Reminders

MINDSET
• Short guided tools: a 10-second check-in, breathing, a sleep wind-down, Small Wins, Reframe, Values, Journal and Gratitude
• Written in advance and the same for everyone
• Stored on your phone, with optional end-to-end encrypted backup

PROGRESS
• Readiness from your sleep, HRV and training load
• Fitness trends (CTL/ATL/TSB), zones and personal records
• Monthly and yearly recaps

CONNECTED
• Apple Health: heart rate, workouts, sleep and body measurements
• Strava: automatic sync both ways
• Home Screen widgets and Live Activities

SAFETY
• A Get help button with crisis lines and emergency numbers, always free
• AI features are for adults only
• Light and dark themes

HaiLife Pro (subscription) unlocks AI coaching, coach-designed layouts, smart training plans, voice coaching, AI meal logging and AI ride summaries. Monthly or annual, managed through your Apple ID.

HaiLife is for general fitness and wellbeing. It is not medical care and does not diagnose any condition.
